_comment_v2: Step 15f-ii: the 'roles' map below is read by cooper-core/retry_policy.py and keys off the same role names as PDA_ModelRouting.json. The legacy 'workers' map and 'dead_letter_folder' describe the retired v1 PowerShell workers and are left intact for the Scripts/ that still read them -- v2 has roles, not workers. Timeouts are per ATTEMPT, so a role's worst case is timeout * (1 + max_retries); they are set generously enough for local gemma inference on the 6GB Private host (~46 tok/s measured, Step 15c) rather than tuned for cloud latency.

classifier.notes: No independent call site since 15a folded it into brain.

brain.notes: User-facing turn; local inference can be slow, so not aggressive.

planner.notes: Envelope drafting is the longest single generation.

reviewer.notes: review.review() and council members; members run concurrently, so wall clock is the slowest member, not the sum.
